name: ORION HEART ~Injoku no Sukumizu Sailor Senshi~
original_name: オリオンハート～淫辱のスク水セーラー戦士～
source:
After defeating the demons, Orion Suns thought she could finally live in peace, enjoying her everyday life and love for Osamu, but she was wrong! The demons were still alive, and worse, their leader, Gildart, has now possessed the boy she loves, using his body to have their way with her! Who else will suffer as the demons run amok while she tries to save her beloved?!

[From [url=http://www.otakustudy.com/2012/07/18-mangagamer-announce-new-acquisitions-at-anime-expo-2012/]OtakuStudy[/url]]
translation:
击败恶魔后，猎户座·森斯以为终于能平静生活，享受日常以及对修的爱，但她错了！恶魔仍然活着，更糟的是，它们的首领吉尔达特如今附身在她深爱的男孩身上，并利用他的身体对她为所欲为！当她试图拯救爱人时，恶魔肆虐还会令谁受害？！

[摘自[url=http://www.otakustudy.com/2012/07/18-mangagamer-announce-new-acquisitions-at-anime-expo-2012/]OtakuStudy[/url]]
